verdict: Netflix's revenue rose 13% to $12.6B and its 33% operating margin turned that into $3.4B of net profit — slower growth than the old days, but a far stronger profit engine.

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: down from $2.3B a year ago on content-spend timing

segments.name: United States & Canada
segments.note: The biggest and richest market — subscription streaming, plus the fast-growing ads business.

segments.name: Europe, Middle East & Africa
segments.note: The second-largest region, growing a bit faster than North America.

segments.name: Latin America
segments.note: The fastest-growing region this quarter (16% after currency effects) — cheaper plans are pulling in new households.

segments.name: Asia-Pacific
segments.note: The smallest region — mobile-first plans in price-sensitive markets.

opex.name: Technology & development
opex.note: The streaming platform, apps, recommendation systems and the new in-house ad-tech stack.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Advertising Netflix itself and winning subscribers.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company: legal, finance and offices.

takeaways.title: A third of revenue is operating profit
takeaways.text: Operating income hit $4.2B (+11%). Content costs grow faster in the first half of the year, so the margin actually dipped from 34.1% a year ago; management expects it to widen again in the second half.

takeaways.title: Ads are becoming a real business
takeaways.text: Netflix says it is on track to roughly double ads revenue to about $3B in 2026 — still small beside subscription revenue, but the fastest-growing layer it has.

takeaways.title: Latin America is the growth pocket
takeaways.text: LATAM revenue grew 21% (16% without currency help), the fastest of the four regions, while the biggest market — the U.S. and Canada — grew 10%.

sources.label: Official earnings release / shareholder letter (SEC EDGAR)

otherDetail: Interest expense of $176M on Netflix's debt, partly offset by $52M of interest and other income — a net $124M cost below operating profit.
follow100Note: The rows reconcile to $100 within a cent of rounding.
